## Release v12.0 - [Major Release](https://docs.mattermost.com/product-overview/release-policy.html#release-types) \{#release-v12-0-major-release}

- **12.0.1, released 2026-10-22**
  - Mattermost v12.0.1 contains Medium severity level security fixes. [Upgrading](https://docs.mattermost.com/upgrade/upgrading-mattermost-server.html) to this release is recommended. Details will be posted on our [security updates page](https://mattermost.com/security-updates/) 30 days after release as per the [Mattermost Responsible Disclosure Policy](https://mattermost.com/security-vulnerability-report/).
  - Go runtime was updated from 1.26.7 to 1.26.10.
  - Pre-packaged Dataminr plugin version [v3.0.0](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-dataminr/releases/tag/v3.0.0).
  - Added the ``EnforceLogPathRoot`` feature flag, disabled by default. When enabled, the server refuses to start, and a configuration save is rejected, if a log or audit file path resolves outside the logging root (``MM_LOG_PATH``, or the default logs directory). Validation now also covers ``LogSettings.FileLocation`` and ``ExperimentalAuditSettings.FileName``.
  - Fixed an issue where a v12 server failed to start when ``SupportEmail``, ``FeedbackEmail``, or ``ReplyToAddress`` held a list of addresses or a value that was not an email address. Such values are now reduced to their first valid address or cleared, and a warning is logged.
  - Fixed an issue where ``mattermost db`` commands reported configuration validation errors as untranslated message IDs.
  - Mattermost v12.0.1 contains no database or functional changes.
- **12.0.0, released 2026-10-16**
  - Original 12.0.0 release.
